-- Declarations and contracts for read_public. Bodies implement the spec.

-- True when a relative path, after resolving "." and "sub/..",
-- stays inside the base directory and is not absolute.
inside_notes(path: str) -> bool =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post out == True or out == False
  ex inside_notes("a.txt") == True
  ex inside_notes("sub/../a.txt") == True
  ex inside_notes("../x") == False
  ex inside_notes("/etc/passwd") == False
  ex inside_notes("sub/../../x") == False
  let parts = path.split("/")
  if parts.len() > 1 and parts[0] == ""
    return False
  var depth = 0
  for part in parts
    if part == "" or part == "."
      continue
    if part == ".."
      depth -= 1
      if depth < 0
        return False
    else
      depth += 1
  True

-- Returns the text of notes/path, or "" if the path escapes notes
-- or the file is missing or unreadable. Reads only through fs
-- confined to the notes directory.
read_public(path: str) -> str uses fs =
  pre path.char_count() >= 0
  post out.char_count() >= 0
  ex read_public("missing.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("../secret.txt") == ""
  ex read_public("/etc/passwd") == ""
  var out = ""
  if inside_notes(path)
    with fs = fs.sub("notes")
      out = fs.read(path) else ""
  out
